name: Lysistratus the Seer
bio: Lysistratus the Seer is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors gives no firm date for the poet. Paton's index lists him as a seer.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 509).

poems.title: Book IX, 509
poems.author: Lysistratus the Seer
poems.text: The women of Colias shall cook with oars,
